title: Computer Graphics: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
programme: Bachelor of Business Information Technology / information Technology
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Define the term computer animation.
List down four main advantages of inkjet printers.
Consider three different raster systems with resolutions of 600 x 400, 1200 x 1000 and 2500 x 2000.
What size is the frame buffer (in bytes) for each of these systems to store 16 bits per pixel?
How much storage (in bytes) is required for each system if 12 bits per pixel are to be stored?
List and briefly explain at least three important applications of computer graphics.
List down the hardware and software that are used in computer graphics.
Define the following terms as used in computer graphics.
Rasterization
Persistence
Briefly explain with a suitable diagram a graphic display device and explain its components.
Explain the differences between a general graphics system designed for a programmer and one designed for a specific application, such as architectural design.
Using the Digital Differential Analyzer line drawing algorithm, scan convert a line starting at point (10,10) and ending at (18,16).
What is aspect ratio?
Explain the merits and demerits of OLED display.

Consider a raster system with a resolution of 1024 x 768 pixels and a colour palette that calls for 65,536 colours. What is the minimum amount of video RAM that the computer must have to support the above-mentioned resolution and number of colours?
Explain the main functions used in Autodesk Maya.
Outline FOUR types of images.
Define the term transformation and explain the main transformation types.
Explain the following terms as used in computer graphics.
Animation
Computer aided design
Video adapter card
Differentiate between pillarboxing and letterboxing.
Using Bresenham's line drawing algorithm, scan convert a line starting at point (0,0) and ending at (8,6).
With a suitable diagram, show the graphic pipelining process.
Discuss the main features of computer graphics.
Consider two raster systems with resolutions of 640 x 480 and 1280 x 1024.
How many pixels could be accessed per second in each of these systems by a display controller that refreshes the screen at a rate of 60 frames per second?
What is the access time per pixel in each system?
